title: Person operating a metalworking lathe
visual_facts: A large gray metalworking machine with a rotating chuck, tool holder, handwheels, and a long bed fills most of the view.
A person in a white hooded top stands at the left, holding a control handle beside the machine.
Small metal chips are scattered in the recessed area below the machine bed.
spatial_relations: The person stands beside the left controls while the chuck and tool assembly are centered.
The long machine bed extends from the center toward the lower right foreground.
uncertainties: The person is cropped and no machine labels are readable, so neither identity nor the exact machine model can be determined.
